name: radio-group
purpose: Exactly one choice from a short, visible set of mutually exclusive options, built on native radios in a <fieldset role="radiogroup"> + <legend>, with required validation and native arrow-key selection.
whenToUse: Choosing one option from 2 to about 7 visible options where comparing them matters.
A required choice with no sensible default.
whenNotToUse: Several independent choices: use Checkbox Group.
Long or searchable lists: use Select or Combobox.
A binary setting that applies immediately: use Switch.
responsive: Vertical by default. `orientation: 'horizontal'` lays options out in a wrapping row. Labels and option help text wrap; each row is at least touch-target-min tall.
rtl: Logical properties and flex layout: radios sit at the inline start and horizontal options flow from the inline start. Native arrow keys follow the browser's direction handling.
theme: Unselected: color-surface ring with a color-border-strong boundary. Selected: color-primary fill with a color-on-primary inner dot. Invalid: color-error-fg boundaries. Forced-colors mode uses Canvas, CanvasText, Highlight, and GrayText with forced-color-adjust: none so the ring and dot stay visible.
security: Legend, option labels, help text, and messages are rendered with textContent. Validation messages never include the selected value. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. With `name`, the selected native radio submits `name=value`. Without `name`, radios share a generated name so they behave as one native group, and nothing identifying is derived from user data.

budgets.budget: < 2 ms average in headless Chromium (target; not yet covered by the performance test)

performance.testedScale: Unit-tested with up to 4 options per group; intended for short lists (up to about 20 options).

limitations: Once a radio is selected the user cannot clear the selection (native behavior); offer an explicit "None" option if needed.
Radios with the same consumer `name` in the same form form one native group, even across RadioGroup instances.
unsupported: HTML inside option labels or the legend.
Custom roving focus (the native behavior is used).
antiPatterns: Pre-selecting an option for a question the user must answer consciously.
Using radios for more than about 7 options.
Reusing the same `name` for unrelated groups.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/radio-group: AuiRadioGroup directive ([auiRadioGroup]) with ControlValueAccessor and Validator.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/radio-group: AuiRadioGroup component; controlled (value/defaultValue + onValueChange) or uncontrolled.
